analysis: talk-led paper export from existing saved predictions

terminology.legacy_acceptance_fields: same fixed-cut passing probability; preserved for compatibility

definitions.table1: Per cell: f=mean(outcome), p=mean(prediction), u_proxy=mean(pointwise prediction_std), s_emp=sqrt(max(f*(1-f),1e-12)/N), z=(f-p)/sqrt(s_emp^2+u_proxy^2), G_k=Phi(k-z)-Phi(-k-z).
definitions.table1_reference_only: Same transform with z=(f-p)/s_emp for all methods.
definitions.figure2_reference_pull: z_ref=(f_bin-p_bin)/Wilson_z1_half_width; supported bins have at least four targets.
definitions.continuum_weighting: Equal bins within each fixed window; equal-window mean of window-specific mean squares before square root; signed means average window means.
definitions.roughness: Mean absolute second difference on each saved 1-keV grid window.
definitions.histogram: Width 0.5 over [-10,10], with explicit underflow and overflow.
definitions.wide_curve_column_names: <illustrative|mean>__<subset_id>__<architecture_id>; illustrative is fixed to initialization seed 0/context seed 100, and mean averages the declared group.
definitions.hierarchical_variation: Within-seed context SD, initialization SD across seed means, and dedicated training-subset SD across the three 5k subset means are reported separately.

uncertainty_availability.table1_neural_proxy: available as mean pointwise SD; descriptive only
uncertainty_availability.figure2_combined_bin_mean: unavailable for every method: per-pass bin means/covariances absent; pointwise SD is insufficient

mc_precision_compatibility.reason: The archived MC study used full-pool models, context size 2,000, training seed 0, and context seed 100; the headline uses original 5k models and context size 500.
mc_precision_compatibility.claim_decision: Omit the smoother-curve claim because independent-stream and grid-spacing diagnostics show material MC-estimator noise.

server_only_policy: Raw event predictions, complete per-cell bin arrays, checkpoints, and row identities remain on server.
historical_data_exposure: Prospectively specified follow-up analysis on historically exposed data; not an untouched test.
